episodeTitle.en: Why securing AI is harder than anyone expected and guardrails are failing | HackAPrompt CEO
episodeTitle.zh: 为何保障AI安全比任何人预期的都困难，防护措施为何失效 | HackAPrompt首席执行官

guestBioOfficial.en: Sander Schulhoff is an AI researcher specializing in AI security, prompt injection, and red teaming. He wrote the first comprehensive guide on prompt engineering and ran the first-ever prompt injection competition, working with top AI labs and companies. His dataset is now used by Fortune 500 companies to benchmark their AI systems security, he’s spent more time than anyone alive studying how attackers break AI systems, and what he’s found isn’t reassuring: the guardrails companies are buying don’t actually work, and we’ve been lucky we haven’t seen more harm so far, only because AI agents aren’t capable enough yet to do real damage. *We discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 桑德·舒尔霍夫是一位专注于AI安全、提示注入和红队技术的研究员。他撰写了首份提示工程综合指南，并举办了首届提示注入竞赛，与顶尖AI实验室和公司合作。他的数据集现已被《财富》500强公司用于基准测试其AI系统安全性。他比任何在世的人都花费了更多时间研究攻击者如何攻破AI系统，而他的发现并不令人安心：公司购买的防护措施实际上并不奏效，我们至今尚未看到更多危害，仅仅是因为AI智能体尚未具备足够的能力造成的。*我们将探讨：*

title.en: Why securing AI is harder than anyone expected and guardrails are failing | HackAPrompt CEO
title.zh: 为何保障AI安全比任何人预期的都困难，防护措施为何失效 | HackAPrompt首席执行官

summary.en: Sander delivers a serious, practical look at AI security: how attackers manipulate models into leaking data or taking harmful actions, and how defenders should harden their systems. He covers the rise of prompt injection, the importance of red-teaming before deployment, and what everyone building with LLMs needs to know to avoid catastrophic failures. The episode is a wake-up call on the real risks of deploying AI.
summary.zh: Sander 对 AI 安全给出了严肃而实用的审视：攻击者如何操纵模型泄露数据或采取有害行动，以及防御者应当如何加固系统。他涵盖了提示注入（prompt injection）的兴起、部署前红队测试的重要性，以及每个用 LLM 构建产品的人为避免灾难性失败所必需了解的知识。本期是对部署 AI 真实风险的一记警钟。
